$comment: Copy to <Project>/Emulator-Testing/config.json (this .example ships with the kit; the real
config never does). `appId` is what Maestro drives (== bundleId on iOS, package name on
Flutter: `platform`:"flutter" + `flutterTarget`:"ios"|"android" plus that target's fields (ios: simulator; android: avd).
`buildDir` is the git-less snapshot dir (EMULATOR_RULES §5) — NEVER build inside the repo.
